simple.meaning: לֹג (lôg) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a log or measure for liquids.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 5 times across Leviticus, beginning at Leviticus 14:10. Its contexts include offering, priesthood.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to לֹג (H3849).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: לֹג (lôg) / H3849 is traced through Leviticus 14:10, Leviticus 14:12, Leviticus 14:15, Leviticus 14:21 as a generated source-based concept entry.
